description.value: MAD Chicken is a takeout stall in Simon Fraser University's MBC Food Court on the Burnaby campus, serving an American-Asian fusion menu of crispy fried chicken, ramen, beef noodle soup, and dumplings. As part of SFU's campus food program, it sits within a large university building with full campus amenities nearby. A touring cyclist ascending Burnaby Mountain would find it a convenient hot-meal stop during the week.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 49m; stands at 58m.
